title: Application Log Source Record
description: Version 1.0 source contract. Required fields are non-null; request_id and latency_ms are optional and nullable. Additional properties are retained by the pipeline.

timestamp.description: Required event timestamp; normalized to UTC.

level.description: Required severity; normalized to the supported severity set.

latency_ms.description: Optional finite non-negative latency in milliseconds; pipeline also applies a configured upper bound.
